queries.name: page_visit_count
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM source

queries.name: page_visit_segments
queries.sql:
SELECT file_row_number//1048576 AS segment,count(*) AS n,
                sum(hash("client_id","timestamp","url")::HUGEINT) AS sum_hash,bit_xor(hash("client_id","timestamp","url")) AS xor_hash
                FROM read_parquet('data/external/synerise/source/page_visit.parquet',file_row_number=true) GROUP BY segment ORDER BY segment

queries.name: page_visit_bounds
queries.sql:
SELECT
                    min(TRY_CAST(timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS first_ts,
                    max(TRY_CAST(timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS last_ts,
                    count_if(TRY_CAST(timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL) AS unusable_ts
                    FROM source

queries.name: page_visit_hourly
queries.sql:
SELECT
                    CAST(timestamp AS DATE) AS date,date_part('hour',CAST(timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS hour,
                    count(*) AS n FROM source GROUP BY date,hour ORDER BY date,hour

queries.name: page_visit_seconds
queries.sql:
SELECT
                    date_part('second',CAST(timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS second,count(*) AS n
                    FROM source GROUP BY second ORDER BY second

queries.name: page_visit_minutes
queries.sql:
SELECT
                    date_part('minute',CAST(timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS minute,count(*) AS n
                    FROM source GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute

queries.name: page_visit_weekday
queries.sql:
SELECT
                    date_part('isodow',CAST(timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS iso_weekday,
                    count(*) AS n,count(DISTINCT CAST(timestamp AS DATE)) AS observed_days
                    FROM source GROUP BY iso_weekday ORDER BY iso_weekday

queries.name: page_visit_segment_ranges
queries.sql:
SELECT
                    file_row_number//1048576 AS segment,min(timestamp) AS first_ts,max(timestamp) AS last_ts
                    FROM read_parquet('data/external/synerise/source/page_visit.parquet',file_row_number=true) GROUP BY segment ORDER BY segment
